name: Capital University
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts university in Bexley, OH. Acceptance rate approximately 73%. 10-year median graduate earnings reported around $54,143. Tuition considered on the higher end among Ohio private four-year colleges.
financial_aid: As an NCAA Division III program, Capital does not offer athletic scholarships; aid is need- and merit-based academic aid. Average net price after aid reported at approximately $23,585. Financial Aid Office publishes an annual Cost of Attendance estimate.
facilities_notes: Athletics facilities include the Clowson Field Complex and Bernlohr Stadium; specific softball field name not confirmed on the softball program page (checked 2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division III softball program competing in the Ohio Athletic Conference. Head coach Anna Kirk entering her fourth season leading the program in 2026-27.
notes: Researched from athletics.capital.edu (note: primary domain is athletics.capital.edu, not gocomets.capital.edu). Coaching staff and roster captured from live pages 2026-07. Assistant coach Bayli Dennison is listed on the staff page with email bpope@capital.edu exactly as published.
